description: This file declares functions related to MSO management HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) operations, including getting and setting MSO Pod seed and validating passwords. It primarily contains function prototypes and include guards, serving as an interface between hardware and higher-level software components.

methods.name: ssp_mso_mgmt_hal_GetMsoPodSeed
methods.description: Retrieves the MSO Pod seed value.

methods.name: ssp_mso_mgmt_hal_SetMsoPodSeed
methods.description: Sets the MSO Pod seed value.

methods.name: ssp_mso_mgmt_hal_MsoValidatePwd
methods.description: Validates the MSO password with given parameters.
